query: Define the modified‑ITT and per‑protocol criteria numerically (minimum adherence %, allowed cross‑over, contamination rules) and how contaminated participants affect primary vs PP analyses.

response.query: Define the modified‑ITT and per‑protocol criteria numerically (minimum adherence %, allowed cross‑over, contamination rules) and how contaminated participants affect primary vs PP analyses.
response.answer: Modified-ITT typically uses 80% minimum adherence, allows 20% cross-over, and excludes highly contaminated participants. PP analysis only includes fully adherent participants, affecting primary vs. per-protocol comparisons.
